abstract: Maintains municipal effluent discharge authorizations and specialized wastewater treatment fees
system_message:
You are the Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV), responsible for maintaining records on municipal industrial effluent discharge authorizations, specialized wastewater treatment tariffs, and site Scope 1 biogenic emissions audits for candidate bioreactor tolling facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal effluent discharge authorizations and specialized wastewater treatment fees（DISCH）
information_points.content:
ENV-DISCH-UZV：For Rhine Biofermentation Works, the municipal industrial effluent discharge permit is active (true) for biological oxygen demand discharge via the facility direct industrial outfall pipeline, and the high-COD wastewater treatment fee for concentrated spent-broth batch discharge is 1,500 EUR per standard batch.
ENV-DISCH-LEZ：For Silesian Bioprocess Consortium, the municipal industrial effluent discharge permit is active (true) for biological oxygen demand discharge into the municipal network via the direct industrial outfall pipeline, and the high-COD wastewater treatment fee for concentrated spent-broth batch discharge is 1,500 EUR per standard batch.
ENV-DISCH-8ZC：For Flanders Microbial Solutions, the municipal industrial effluent discharge permit is not active (false) for industrial outfall pipeline discharge into the municipal network, while the high-COD wastewater treatment fee for concentrated spent-broth batch biological pretreatment is 1,500 EUR per standard batch.

information_points.title: Scope 1 emissions audit（CARBON）
information_points.content:
ENV-CARBON-RTP：According to the annual site greenhouse gas emissions declaration for Flanders Microbial Solutions, the direct biogenic carbon emissions intensity measured at the off-gas stack scrubbers during full microbial fermentation cycles is 145 kg/t of crude biomass produced.
ENV-CARBON-TNU：According to the annual site greenhouse gas emissions declaration for Silesian Bioprocess Consortium, the direct biogenic carbon emissions intensity measured at the off-gas stack scrubbers during full microbial fermentation cycles is 110 kg/t of crude biomass produced.
ENV-CARBON-881：According to the annual site greenhouse gas emissions declaration for Rhine Biofermentation Works, the direct biogenic carbon emissions intensity measured at the off-gas stack scrubbers during full microbial fermentation cycles is 180 kg/t of crude biomass produced.
